note_tweet.text:
One day, 

Reid Wiseman was chatting with his friend. 

His friend asked：
"You're going on a trip in a few days, right? 
Where are you going?" 

Reid Wiseman smiled mysteriously and said
"You'll find out when the time comes." 

A few days later...

his friend suddenly noticed that Reid Wiseman's IP address had changed to... the Moon. 

The friend was shocked and immediately messaged him: 
"What the hell?! You went to the Moon???"

Reid Wiseman calmly replied：
"Yeah, I told you-you'd find out when the time comes."
